title: Rubric - Categorization
evidence: All 30 criteria reviewed: format_gate (n=1-5) correctly cover file existence, archive structure, and ZIP contents; correctness (n=6-15, 24-30) correctly cover telemetry format/values, behavior/mechanics, data consistency, timing, and HUD text wording; visual (n=16-23) correctly cover rendering, layout, legibility, appearance, and grid structure. Three MUST-PASS gates (n=1,2,3) are each pure file-existence checks with no bundled non-gate content. Zero miscategorizations found (0/30 = 0%).
minor_issues: Criterion 25 (correctness): 'The HUD text in bomb_blast_frame.png reproduces the exact wording and line breaks of the corresponding expected file.' This criterion tests both correctness (exact wording is content, per calibration: 'A value inside a visual element is correctness') and visual (line breaks are a layout/typography property). Fix: split into (a) correctness criterion testing exact wording match, and (b) visual criterion testing line break placement. Target pairs: correctness/REGULAR for wording, visual/REGULAR for line breaks.
